description.to:
Outcome: Shared modules that build {tenantId, role, mode} from an AppSync event's identity (claim names from the auth spike), refuse an IAM call without an explicit tenant on a shared stack, and return the fixed tenant on a dedicated stack. Handlers adopt it in parts 2 to 4 (content-actions; the TypeScript functions; plugin functions and cli-login). Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) tenant-context, branch feature/<this issue id>-tenant-context from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-tenant-context, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new src/papyrus_content/tenant_context.py, new amplify/functions/shared/tenant-context.ts, tests.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/function-tenant-context.feature):
Scenario: An IAM call without a tenant is refused on a shared stack
    Given tenancy mode shared and an IAM event with no tenant
    When the context is built
    Then it raises a refusal before any read

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-867f76, PPY-46635e. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/tenant_context_test.py; npx tsx --test scripts/test-tenant-context.ts; npm run typecheck.
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
